subject: Re: Air freight quote to TLV
body:
Hi there,

Our buyer has just withdrawn the order, so we need to cancel the shipment. Please don’t book it. If you’ve already booked it, please cancel the booking.

Sorry for the last-minute change, and thanks for your help!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The customer says the order was withdrawn and asks us not to book or to cancel the shipment.
